description: sandbox: the checkout/worktree convention, enforced — a PreToolUse guard that denies Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit on git-tracked files when the session's cwd is a main checkout (the direction the harness's own worktree guard does not cover). Fails open on any git error; escape hatches SANDBOX_ALLOW_CHECKOUT_EDITS=1 (deprecated alias CLAUDE_KIT_ALLOW_CHECKOUT_EDITS=1) and per-repo allow/deny path rules in .claude/allow-checkout-edits (implicit first deny *, last match wins; an empty or broken file allows nothing), a file the edit tools may not write. Announced up front: a SessionStart and SubagentStart notice puts one factual paragraph into the context of each session and sub-agent whose cwd is a main checkout the guard is on for, saying Bash writes are not checked; it prints nothing when the guard is off or the rules allow every file.
